ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: BibleAlpha uses the camera only to scan the QR code of the church screen.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BibleAlpha uses the microphone so you can dictate your messages and questions.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: BibleAlpha turns your voice into text when you dictate messages and questions.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BibleAlpha does not access your photos. This permission is only requested if you choose to save or share an image.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: BibleAlpha saves an image to your photos only when you choose to save it.
